comments.body:
Does it look like this one? I think so.
https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/149179317

@radhaveach , Hello Radha, the plant in this observation does not seem to be woody. Also, the lower part of leaf, petiole , younger stems and bract-like structures near the flower were not having glands and were not sticky to touch. I don't know whether these are young plants which will grow to be woody shrubs. Stylosanthes fruticosa (the woody - shrubby species) is present in the nearby hills of Pune.
